items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Selma Green was the organ player at the church, and she was very good. But that’s about as far as I got.

ctx.x: Do you recall, or had you heard any of the local musicians perform?

Well, you know, Selma Green was the organ player at the church, and she was very good. But that’s about as far as I got. My father would play the classical composers like Rachmaninoff and Beethoven and Chopin and all those guys. So I heard that from my father.
